purpose: Form CAA-16 is used for filing a declaration at the stage of submission of an application under section 230 of the Act in case of a compromise, arrangement, merger, or demerger between an Indian company and a company or body corporate incorporated in a country which shares a land border with India.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: At the stage of submission of application under section 230 of the Act.
steps: Comply with sections 230 to 232 of the Act and the rules.
Obtain prior approval of the Reserve Bank of India if required.
Prepare the declaration in Form No. CAA-16.
Submit the application under section 230 of the Act along with the declaration.
checklist: Check if the company or body corporate is incorporated in a country that shares a land border with India.
Ensure the application is at the stage of submission under section 230 of the Act.
Ensure Form No. CAA-16 declaration is completed.
watch: A declaration in Form No. CAA-16 is required at the stage of submission of application under section 230 of the Act for entities from countries sharing a land border with India.
